countingRule: One named regression counts once; loops and payload variants are not additional independent scenarios. Some tests also run authorized controls.
limits: No real model attack-success estimate, real remote account or user-directory access. Each layer is reported separately. Unknown effect stays unknown. Invariant/recovery controls are counted separately from adversarial regressions. Labels are asserted outcomes, not independent evidence beyond the linked test.
